comment: e2m 10B1 +0 Restart_Oil_Pressure_Shutdown '[EPRYO2SO] EPF SHUTDOWN ENGINE COMMAND FROM RESTART LIMITATION ALGORITHM.' (UNITLESS; 0 in the dump): the shutdown command of the engine protection restart limitation algorithm. protection_state_transition (called for the active channel by governor_fault_derateCalc_channelIter) writes it in the branch for channel index 4: when the channel's consecutive shutdown count has reached DAT_0005c2f4 (e2m 10B9 +0 Shutdown_Max_Limit) and the channel's shutdown delay (configuration word +0x1e) is below the record word at +6. cm848_updateEngineProtectionShutdown then sets engine_shutdown_command_flag (e2m 10B1 +12 Shutdown) when it is non-zero. This calibration's channel table has a single channel (index 0, fuel temperature), so the flag is never set. The e2m labels the algorithm the oil pressure one (EPRYO2): the code only shows channel index 4. This ROM's channel loop starts at enable bit 128 (e2m 106B +12, where index 0 is the fuel temperature channel, bits 130 / 131 = shutdown / restart enable) and the oil pressure enables sit in the word before it (e2m 106B +10 bits 12-15), so the oil pressure label is not confirmed.
